title: Streets of New Capenna Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A city-plane ruled by five crime families.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: One of the five crime families of New Capenna, associated with food, family and the Halo.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A prized source of power in New Capenna that the Cabaretti are tied to.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A teenage girl who turned out to be the source of the Cabaretti's Halo.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: One of the five crime families of New Capenna, based in the Cloud Spire and known for spies and progress.

entities.name: Cloud Spire
entities.description: The Obscura's tower dominating the skyline of New Capenna.

entities.name: Vantoleone
entities.description: A figure whose family was attacked, shattering the balance of power in the city.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: A borough of New Capenna with labyrinths of tunnels beneath its streets.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker and demon who has not made a conquest in over a thousand years.

entities.name: Kitt Kanto
entities.description: A singer who survived assassins by holding a high note.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: A leader of the Cabaretti.

entities.name: Jinnie Fay
entities.description: Jetmir's second, who watches his back.

entities.name: Ziatora
entities.description: Leader of the Riveteers.

entities.name: Ognis
entities.description: Ziatora's second-in-command, who appears where enemies least expect her.

entities.name: Calvey
entities.description: A funeral director.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: One of the five crime families of New Capenna.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: One of the five crime families of New Capenna, keepers of secrets.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: One of the five crime families of New Capenna.

entities.name: Vanto Beatdown
entities.description: A citywide dance-battle obsession that began at the Rose Room lounge.

entities.name: Rose Room
entities.description: A lounge where the Vanto Beatdown began.

events.summary: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo is revealed to be a single teenage girl, Giada.
events.quote: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

events.summary: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the balance of power shatters and the city descends into chaos.
events.quote: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the fragile balance of power shattered completely, and the city descended into chaos.

events.summary: The Vanto Beatdown begins as a dance-battle at the Rose Room and becomes a citywide obsession.
events.quote: The Vanto Beatdown began as an improvised dance-battle at the Rose Room lounge.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis smiles, a thousand years after his last conquest.
Kitt Kanto survives assassins by holding a high note for nearly a minute.
events.quote: As the assassins converged on Kitt Kanto, she struck a high note and held it, unbroken, for nearly a minute.

events.summary: For years the five families ruled New Capenna in uneasy peace.
events.quote: For years, the five families ruled New Capenna in uneasy peace, and the city prospered.

relations.note: Giada is the source of the Cabaretti's Halo
relations.quote: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

relations.note: She is Jetmir's second and watches his back
relations.quote: She watches Jetmir's back while her companions watch hers.
Ziatora's second-in-command has a habit of appearing when and where her enemies least expect her.

relations.note: The Cloud Spire is the Obscura's tower
relations.quote: The Obscura's Cloud Spire dominates the skyline, its eye a beacon of progress that sees all.
